scalars.scalar_value: Any combination equivalent to: Bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, or social/educational research and five years responsible experience involving related research and analysis activities and projects.

items.item_text: Any combination equivalent to: Bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, or social/educational research and five years responsible experience involving related research and analysis activities and projects.

Perform and lead statistical and technical planning, design, research, and evaluation duties related to institutional projects. Lead the process of evaluating academic and student services programs. Determine and utilize appropriate statistical procedures and sampling techniques to ensure high levels of confidence and reliability in survey analyses and research projects. Oversee and prepare reports for college personnel and state agencies to fulfill compliance regulations and requirements and to assure institutional matriculation effectiveness for appropriate funding. Design, implement, and evaluate survey results, including communication of results to the campus community. Research, identify sources, and prepare and revise reports with accompanying tabular, graphical, and statistical contents, descriptions of analytical methods used and narrative of findings and conclusions. Query institutional databases related to student enrollment projections, follow-up studies and analyses of program enrollment patterns. Conduct qualitative research, such as focus groups and individual interviews. Create, develop, and maintain databases related to student enrollment projections, follow-up studies and analyses of program enrollment patterns. Provide expert support, consultation, and analysis for enrollment management, equity, and student success initiatives; provide requested data and suggest additional data and analyses, as appropriate Develop and share code for use in data preparation and analysis. Create project and database documentation. Provide guidance and support to institutional research analysts, data coaches, and other personnel on how to access, interpret, and communicate data and research findings. Extract data from a variety of external data sets and data marts such as the CCCCO Data Mart, Census, Bureau of Labor Statistics, CSU Analytics, COCI, Assist.org, etc. Use a variety of software packages for data analysis, data collation, data management, graphics, and word processing (e.g., Tableau, R, SPSS, Cognos, Excel, PowerPoint). Communicate with appropriate college staff, stakeholders and other community college districts in analysis, compilation, and interpretation of data. Prepares research agendas and calendars; tracks progress of research projects. Respond to research questions as requested; describe findings. Serve on committees and attend meetings as assigned.
